featured_reviews.name: Ramsha Tausalkar
featured_reviews.review_text: This 44 year old Desi Chinese chain in Bandra sure lives up to its reputation. My Tiffin is a frills free joint, with all its delight packed inside the food. We had the Seafood Noodles that had a lot of fish and prawns, the Chicken Wantons in which the winner was the red sauce, Cracking Fish Rice which had a crunch in every bite and the Dragon Chicken Sizzler that had noodled and a red chicken gravy topped off with fries. featured_reviews.review_text: This 44 year old restaurant serves authentic Chinese since 1980 love this place alot they hav best Chinese food i tried their mocktails & cranberry iced tea , Tiffin special soup was delicious then for d starter i tried Sesme toast & Chicken wongton fry their red sauce has real magic for wongtons 😍🤌🏻Chicken pot noodles were fully loaded nd lastly tried their korean rice 🍚 this place is a must visit guys

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Pandey
featured_reviews.review_text:
Food:* 4.5/5

The real star of the show was the food. We ordered the following dishes:

- *Sesame Paneer Tikka:* A game-changer! The paneer was cooked to perfection, with a beautiful balance of crispy exterior and soft interior. The sesame seeds added a delightful crunch and nutty flavor.
- *Sizzler:* A MUST-TRY! The sizzler was a masterclass in textures and flavors. The vegetables were cooked just right, and the sauce was tangy and savory. The portion size was generous, and the sizzling hot plate added to the drama.

featured_reviews.name: C
featured_reviews.review_text:
Takes multiple holidays EVERY WEEK.

Says he's sorry to inform. I don't think so.

If you want to take holiday every week, you better shut off your business. Clearly, you don't know how to do service.

Increased price by rs. 10 without any whatsoever modifications in the tiffin and asked us to somehow magically “understand.”

Why should I? My money is getting wasted because I still get the same bland food, no new vegetable dishes, hardly any specials as was “promised” when I had enquired. Infact, the menu is pretty much narrowed after the price hike despite it not being rainy season YET.

Terrible food tiffin service.

Not to mention that this tiffin service didn't even serve on 31st December night. When it should have, considering the party environment  outside which is not really safe at night.

He serves to students, even then, he will take so much more holidays than what was said by him when asked. He said 2 per month, which would be sundays. But since past few months, he's been taking as many as 3 one week accounting up to 5-6 per month.

And even after everything, we still get the tiffin late. Pray tell, why do I even pay and what do I even pay you for??? One time, I got cold tiffin food delivered at 11 PM at night. I'm not even kidding. And he had pretty rudely handled the phone calls of enquiry asking me to cancel the tiffin and get food from somewhere else.

Very pathetic service. Don't recommend it to anyone. It's not a “tiffin” service at all.

Just made for namesake so as to loot the poor students.

What truly sets KHANNA TIFFIN & CATERING SERVICE apart is their outstanding customer service. The team was responsive, accommodating special requests, and ensuring a smooth delivery process. Their professionalism and commitment to customer satisfaction were evident throughout the entire experience.

Overall, I highly recommend KHANNA TIFFIN & CATERING SERVICE for anyone seeking delicious, convenient, and top-notch catering services. Whether it's for a small gathering or a large event, you can trust them to deliver an unforgettable culinary experience. I look forward to ordering from them again soon!"

featured_reviews.name: ANIKET KUNDU
featured_reviews.review_text:
Subject: Heartfelt Appreciation & A Few Suggestions for CampusHunger!

To the entire team at CampusHunger The Daily Tiffin Service,

I am writing to express my immense satisfaction with your service. Your commitment to providing homely, fresh, and delicious food is truly commendable and is the primary reason I am a loyal customer.

The food consistently reminds me of home-cooked meals, which is a rare and valuable quality in a tiffin service. I am particularly a huge fan of your Chicken Curry and Fish Fry – both dishes are absolutely stellar and something I always look forward to.

As a passionate food lover, I also have a few suggestions for your menu that I believe would be wonderfully received. I would be absolutely thrilled if you could introduce special thalis such as Prawn Thali, Bombil Thali, Pomfret Thali, and Mutton Thali. I am also always eager to try any other regional fish recipes you might feature.

Finally, I want to applaud you for maintaining such high quality while keeping your prices affordable. This balance is invaluable for students and professionals alike.

Thank you for the great work. Please keep serving the good food!

Best regards,
Aniket Kundu
